name: Points-differential baseline
role: BASELINE — not a candidate for the leaderboard
hypothesis: A club's season-to-date scoring margin per game is a better predictor of its next result than its win-loss record, because margin carries more information per game than a binary outcome.
inputs: PF, PA, games played per club
data_note: Official 2026 league standings give PF, PA and games played for all 32 clubs (S03).
result_note: NOT RUN. No backtest has been executed; no numeric result is claimed.
reason: Published as the mandatory comparison for every other entry, per SG08 and Q19.

name: Availability shock
hypothesis: When a club loses a starter to an Out designation, the market's adjustment is slower or smaller than a simple replacement-value estimate implies, so a fair-value line diverges from the posted number for a short window.
inputs: Injury report game status, roster status codes, derived depth rank
data_note: Injury status is official and captured (S01). Depth rank is derived only (S08, S07). Snap counts are absent (Q05), so replacement magnitude cannot be measured yet, only assumed — and an assumed magnitude is exactly what this project refuses to publish.
reason: Cannot be sized without snap data and cannot be tested for edge without a price feed.

name: Rest and travel asymmetry
hypothesis: Unequal rest between two clubs, combined with long travel, produces a small but persistent adjustment that a simple scoring model misses.
inputs: Kickoff timestamps, prior game dates, venue locations
data_note: Schedules give kickoff times and venues (S04) and the league calendar confirms two international games in consecutive weeks (S05). A complete prior-game date table per club is not yet captured.
reason: Needs a full season of prior-game dates plus a price feed. A well-known effect, so G4 against baseline will be the hard test.

name: Weather-adjusted total
hypothesis: Forecast wind and precipitation at outdoor venues shift the total in a direction the posted number has not fully absorbed.
inputs: NWS point forecast, venue and roof type
data_note: Official free forecasts exist (S11). No official stadium roof/surface registry was verified, so the outdoor determination for each venue is not yet sourced.
reason: Blocked on a sourced roof registry and on a price feed.

name: Two-leg same-game combo
hypothesis: Two legs whose outcomes are positively correlated are underpriced when the book multiplies independent probabilities.
inputs: Joint outcomes of both legs, same game, repeated across many games
data_note: Requires the same pairing to be observed many times. That joint dataset does not exist in this repo.
reason: Correlation cannot be estimated from one game. Must wait until each leg has independently cleared every gate (SG07).

name: Player-prop combo
hypothesis: Two player props in the same game share a game-script dependency, so their joint probability differs materially from the product of their marginals.
inputs: Player-level game logs, snap share, target and carry share
data_note: No player-level historical log is captured, and no prop line source exists. Q11 applies.
reason: Cannot even confirm an official player-log source for the required fields in this session.
